items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: except for great players I sat next to like Brookmeyer and people like that.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. He’s a master. I thank Don a lot because he was actually — I learned more about music from this one teacher at the Manhattan School of Music than anybody I’ve ever learned in my life except for great players I sat next to like Brookmeyer and people like that. But I have to thank Don because he was the one the guy who told me to go back to school. And I went back to school because he thought it was the thing to do and that’s what I did. And I studied with this one teacher, Yolanda Eulayla. Eulayla is her…
Well let me try this one on you.
